sentences.text: Xenicus longipes perditus is a subspecies of the bushwren, a bird belonging to the family Acanthisittidae.
This specific subspecies was formally described by Verry and colleagues.
The bird lived in New Zealand during the Holocene epoch.
Its genus, Xenicus, existed from the Late Pleistocene to the Holocene, spanning 0.129 to 0 million years ago.
